In nonmodular characteristic, Fourier B_k=B_{-k}B_{2k}, opposite-frequency reciprocality and 2-orbits yield 1 inactive or d active choices for each Frobenius coset and dimension b+Lft of the fixed space. In modular char p, the augmentation-zero leading J-adic term forces zero, while truncated log/exp for augmentation-one solutions gives h free coefficients; Y iota(Y)=1 and T_Y conjugate to inversion supply fixed dimension (p+1)/2. The equations cover the zero idempotent and all odd finite fields. Independently re-enumerated direct multiplication in F_q[R_{2p}] for (p,q)=(3,3),(3,5),(5,3), obtaining 28,96,184.
